choicesEn: The ability of an atom to form a certain number of chemical bonds
choicesUz: Atomning ma'lum miqdordagi kimyoviy bog'lanishlar hosil qilish qobiliyati
explanationEn: Valency shows how many bonds an atom can form.
explanationUz: Valentlik atomning qancha bog'lanishi mumkinligini ko'rsatadi.
